abort.already_configured: This GWN Manager and App ID are already configured

data.scan_interval: Update interval for all other data
data.ssid_filter: Only track clients of these SSIDs

data_description.presence_interval: How often to check which clients are connected. Connects and disconnects show up in GWN Manager right away.
data_description.away_delay: A client is only reported away after being disconnected this long, so phones briefly dropping Wi-Fi don't flap. 0 = immediately.
data_description.scan_interval: Offline clients, devices and device details. GWN Manager refreshes signal strength and other measurements only every ~90 s.
data_description.track_offline_clients: Create entities for all clients known to GWN Manager, not only for currently connected ones
data_description.ssid_filter: Leave empty to track clients of all SSIDs. Entities of clients that are already set up are kept.
data_description.manual_uplinks: One line per client: client = device or client = device:port, using names or MACs, e.g. "zigbee-hub = Office AP:LAN". For devices behind an AP's LAN port, which GWN Manager attributes to the router.
data_description.fast_syslog: Receive the access points' syslog messages: connects, disconnects and roaming show up within a second. In GWN Manager set the syslog server to this Home Assistant host, the port below and level notice.
data_description.syslog_port: Port Home Assistant listens on. Use the same port in GWN Manager.
data_description.syslog_debug_events: Also evaluate the detailed events (signal, rate, channel at connect) the devices only send at syslog level debug – about four times as many messages.
data_description.fast_snmp: Read signal and rate of the Wi-Fi clients directly from the devices (SNMP v2c, enable it in GWN Manager). Devices are detected automatically.
data_description.snmp_community: Read community set in GWN Manager.
data_description.snmp_interval: Pause between two SNMP rounds; one round of all devices takes about 10–15 s.
data_description.remove_after_days: Clients not connected for longer than this are removed from Home Assistant with their entities, and come back when they connect again. 0 = never. Not connected clients can also be deleted by hand on their device page.
data_description.syslog_forward: Send every received syslog message unchanged to these addresses as well, e.g. to analyse the same stream with another tool or a second Home Assistant. Comma separated IPv4 addresses with port, like 10.0.0.3:5514 (no host names). Needs fast updates via syslog.

init.description: Syslog and SNMP are switched on in GWN Manager under System settings: {settings_url}

error.invalid_forward: Enter IPv4 addresses with port like 10.0.0.3:5514, separated by commas; not this Home Assistant itself (loopback, its own addresses) on the receiving port.

syslog_port_unavailable.title: Syslog port {port} unavailable
syslog_port_unavailable.description: GWN Manager could not listen for syslog messages on UDP port {port} ({error}). Fast updates via syslog are off; everything else keeps working. Choose another port in the integration's options and set the same port as syslog server port in GWN Manager.
